title: Kissed Venezuelan Olive Skewers
description: A resinous, crispy solo-dinner dish featuring green olives and katsuramuki, finished with a bright olive oil and lime vinaigrette.
instructions: Preheat a gas grill to medium-high heat (about 200°C).
Thread each skewer with three green olive halves and alternate with a slice of katsuramuki.
Whisk together the olive oil, lime juice, minced garlic, oregano, salt, pepper, peppercorns, and chili flakes to make a vinaigrette.
Brush the vinaigrette over the skewers, ensuring all pieces are coated.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until the katsuramuki is slightly charred and the olives are glossy.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle chopped coriander over them.
Serve immediately as a solo dinner entrée, optionally with a side of quinoa or a fresh green salad.
If desired, store leftover skewers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
